description.text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that studies cross-border transactions of goods and services, international capital flows, and the coordination of economic policies, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, management, law, and statistics. This major focuses on global resource allocation, international trade rules, and cross-border business operations, aiming to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective and practical abilities, and to meet the demands of fields such as cross-border trade, international investment, and cross-border e-commerce in the context of globalization.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Liaoning University Of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application Form for International Students of Liaoning University of TechnologyA copy of the first 8 pages of the s passport;Copies of high school graduation certificates and transcripts along with their Chinese translations;Guarantee letters from parents or other guarantors; A certificate of no criminal record within six months prior to the application date.

requirements.text: Aged 18 to 25, with a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications of 12 years of educational background.If one studies in Chinese, one needs to pass the HSK Level 4 exam.If pursuing an engineering degree, mathematics grades must account for at least 60% of the total score.
